copy.lede: Gary, Jean and the team at Windsor & Eton Renovations take on kitchens, bathrooms, brickwork, damp and flooring around Windsor. Customers describe full back-to-brick renovations and quick help when a plumbing problem stalls a bathroom.
copy.about_alt: A navy shaker kitchen with white metro tiles, fitted by Windsor & Eton Renovations

steps.text: Old kitchen out, walls back to plaster, services moved where they need to be.

steps.text: Units in and worktops templated and fitted.

steps.text: Tiled, lit and handed over ready to cook in.
